Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          users:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u | u.LoanedBook->exists(l | l.IsReturned = false and l.OverDue31Days = true) and u.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            precondition:
          users.isEmpty() = false
            
            postcondition:
          users->forAll(u:User | u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre - 1 and ((u.SuspensionDays <> 0 and u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus@pre) or (u.SuspensionDays = 0 and u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND)))
            
        }
